# AGENTS.md

VitePress blog for ACM solutions. Authored content lives in sibling repo `..\acm-icpc`; this repo hosts the site.

## Generated files — never edit directly
- `docs/solutions/**`, `docs/solutions/index.md`, and `docs/.vitepress/solutionIndex.json` are generated by `npm run sync`.
- Author solutions in `..\acm-icpc\solutions\<platform_dir>\<name>_solution.md` (optional frontmatter `tags` / `difficulty` / `source`, followed by `# 标题`), then run `npm run sync`.
- Tag vocabulary lives only in `..\acm-icpc\.skill\SKILL.md` under `## 标签词表`. Alias mappings live in `scripts/plugins/tag-dict.mjs` (`ALIAS_RULES`).
- `docs/.vitepress/problemCache.json` caches Luogu difficulty (30d TTL) and CF ratings (6h TTL for unrated).
- `docs/index.md` and `docs/stats.md` are hand-written shells mounting `HomeLuogu.vue` and `StatsPage.vue`.

## Commands
- `npm run dev` — local dev server at `http://localhost:5173/acm-blog/`
- `npm run sync` — sync solutions and `extraDirs` (`useful_maths_conclusions`) from `..\acm-icpc`, run plugins, validate, incrementally write `docs/solutions/` and `solutionIndex.json`, and refresh `docs/.vitepress/theme/profile.json`. Override source repo via `$env:ACM_ICPC_ROOT`.
- `npm run sync -- --check` — verify outputs match repo without writing (`--offline` skips network).
- `npm run luogu` — refresh Luogu profile stats and name color in `docs/.vitepress/theme/profile.json` (used both locally and in `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` before `npm run build`).
- `npm test` — run `node --test` unit tests under `tests/`.
- `npm run build` / `npm run preview` — build production bundle and preview at `http://localhost:4173/acm-blog/` (restart `preview` after every rebuild; full-site search only works in production builds).

## Plugin pipeline (`scripts/`)
- `scripts/sync.mjs` orchestrates: collect files → `onSolution(sol, ctx)` → build index → `onFinish(index, ctx)` → validate → write changed files & prune stale.
- Registered in `scripts/plugins/index.mjs`:
  - `frontmatter` — regex parser for `tags`, `difficulty`, `source`.
  - `infer-meta` — validates/infers tags against `SKILL.md` vocabulary + `ALIAS_RULES`.
  - `problem-link` — infers `source` URL for Luogu / CF / Gym / AtCoder.
  - `difficulty` — fetches & caches Luogu 9-tier difficulty (`docs/.vitepress/theme/luoguDifficulty.js`) and CF ratings.
  - `git-date` — sets `date` to the first commit adding `sol.srcRel` in `acm-icpc` (`--diff-filter=A`).
  - `collapse-code` — wraps `## 参考代码` in `::: details 点击展开参考代码`.
  - `luogu-user` — fetches Luogu user info (`uid`, `name`, `slogan`, `color`, `followers`, `following`, `passed`, `submitted`, `ranking`) and merges into `docs/.vitepress/theme/profile.json`.
- Category display names are mapped in `scripts/lib/category.mjs` (`categoryName()`).

## Architecture & conventions
- `docs/.vitepress/config.mjs`: keep `appearance: false` and `lang: 'zh-CN'` at top level; `base` is `/acm-blog/`.
- Search (`themeConfig.search` in `config.mjs`): `cjkTokenize` must stay self-contained (serialized to client via `new Function`). `_render` is build-time only, strips `## 参考代码`, and injects solution `id` + `tags` from `solutionIndex.json`.
- Luogu profile data in `docs/.vitepress/theme/profile.json` drives author name color (`profile.color`) and stats across `HomeLuogu.vue`, `ArticleHeader.vue`, and `NavLuogu.vue`. CI runs `npm run luogu` prior to `npm run build` so every deployment reflects the latest Luogu status and name color.
- Line endings are pinned to LF via `.gitattributes` (`* text=auto eol=lf`).
- Luogu visual style: no shadows, 4px radius, no emoji, no extra dependencies.
- Commit only tracked sources under `docs/`, `scripts/`, `tests/`, `.github/workflows/`, `AGENTS.md`, `README.md`, and `package*.json`.
